observations: Base host: all 151 API entries go to https://staging-api.teeinblue.com == expected_api_base (TIB_API_BASE). 20 PUTs go to oe-cdn.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com (host_not_in_expected_api_base, APIOP-011).
158 entries in 42 captures labeled: mapped 136, polling 15, unrelated 7, unknown 0; 28 APIOPs, every one traces to >= 1 ACT-ID.

Upload flow (both libraries, 20 chains): POST /api/users/{user_id}/temporary-files/upload-url -> PUT presigned Spaces URL -> POST /api/layer-images/by-temporary-file | /api/mockup-layers/by-temporary-file -> GraphQL get(ids) status poll every 2.0 s until url set -> list reload. Chain links verified by data (path, temporary_file_id) in 20/20.

Image-layer library is GraphQL-backed for reads/rename (layer_images_connection cursor 20/page, update_layer_images) and REST for categories, move, delete, in-use; mockup-layer library is REST throughout except the status poll (mockup_layers get).

Category endpoints differ: image categories POST {name, type:'clipart'} and GET ?type=clipart; mockup categories have no type. Deleting a category (204) leaves its images uncategorized in both libraries (1 sample each).
Non-image content (33 B text named .png) is rejected at by-temporary-file with 422 errors.temporary_file_id in BOTH libraries (1 sample each).
Presigned URL: X-Amz-Expires=300 (20/20), bucket prefix teeinblue-staging/temporary-files/<date>/ - this was 'not observable' in published KB-050 (response was fully redacted then).

DELETE /api/layer-images/{id} carries the full current artwork JSON as body; 400 'This image has already been added to the current artwork.' when the posted (unsaved) artwork references the image. DELETE /api/mockup-layers/{id} has no body.
assumptions: GraphQL get(ids) calls are labeled 'polling' (client-initiated status poll inside the action window, fixed 2.0 s cadence, stops on completion) and still mapped to APIOP-013/025 and their ACT-IDs.
staging-sdk star-maps JSON in ACT-01-09-001 labeled unrelated: static editor data, explorer note says no library API on select.
'Daily' quota for by-temporary-file is inferred from x-ratelimit-reset starting at 86400.
unknowns: host_not_in_expected_api_base: oe-cdn.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com (APIOP-011) - config has no environments.staging.additional_api_hosts; operator must confirm before items depending on it are oracle_eligible. Not edited config.

Single-sample rules (confidence LOW, no required/enum/boundary inferred): whitespace category name 422 (APIOP-006, APIOP-019: 1 each); GET/PUT/DELETE category by id (1 each per library); category delete -> images uncategorized (1 per library); empty image name accepted (APIOP-014, 1); move with category_id null accepted (APIOP-015, 1); DELETE image 400 in-use (APIOP-016, 1); in-use returns [] (APIOP-017/028, 1 each, non-empty never seen); by-temporary-file 422 non-image (APIOP-012/024, 1 each); 27 MB accepted (1 per library, upper bound unknown); relay search _ilike and after-cursor (1 each); mockup s= search (1); 422 not consuming rate-limit quota (1).
Whether DELETE /api/layer-images/{id} also checks saved artworks other than the posted one.
Whether the temp file in storage is cleaned after a 422.
Last DELETE in ACT-01-10-004 (11163): no status captured; deletion confirmed only by portal final-leftover-check, not by network.
Server-side enforcement of x-acting-user-id / tenant isolation for library ids (not tested).

conflicts.topic: Mockup upload of non-image file disguised as .png

side_a.claim: backend accepts the fake png, creates mockup_layers row (width 0, height 0, urls ''), card stuck 'Rendering' forever, no error

side_b.claim: POST /api/mockup-layers/by-temporary-file -> 422 {message/errors.temporary_file_id: 'This file type is not supported. Please upload a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.'}; no row created (GET list unchanged)

conflicts.note: Same behaviour in image library (ACT-01-05-001). Old rows 4502/4503 from KB-081 still present. Not resolved by api-explorer (§8).

conflicts.topic: Automatic polling for mockup render status

side_a.claim: no automatic polling after mockup shows 'Rendering' (0 entries in 8.2 s); user must click Refresh (.la-sync) which re-queries GraphQL 'mockups'

side_b.claim: media library modal polls GraphQL mockup_layers(ids) every 2.0 s after upload until url is set, then reloads list

conflicts.note: Scope may differ: KB-084 is the product-base mockup card after assignment (resource 'mockups'); side_b is the media library modal after upload (resource 'mockup_layers'). Recorded so orchestrator/reviewer can decide whether this is a conflict or two distinct mechanisms.

side_a.claim: selecting 5 files at once -> only 3 upload-url requests, 2 files silently dropped

side_b.source: raw/network/ACT-02-04-002.json (4 upload-url, 4 by-temporary-file 201 for 4 raster files) and ACT-01-04-003.json (6/6 in image library)

conflicts.note: Not the same input: mockup sample had 4 raster files (svg rejected client-side), so 5 raster files were not re-tested in the mockup library. Partial evidence only; not a resolution.

conflicts.topic: New evidence for existing CONF-API-CTX20260921-03-01 (GET /api/layer-image-categories?type=clipart [] vs GraphQL clipart_categories 10 rows)

side_a.claim: REST returns [] while GraphQL returns 10 rows 'for the same category'

side_b.claim: In one session: REST list returned exactly the row created via POST /api/layer-image-categories (id 37, type clipart) while GraphQL clipart_categories returned ids 5987-6029 without 37; the two id sets never overlap

conflicts.note: Inferred reading (not asserted): the two calls read different collections (image-library categories vs Clipart Categories), which would explain [] vs 10 rows without a data/cache defect. Resolution belongs to orchestrator/reviewer.

label_reason_legend.R-API-ACTION: request to expected_api_base in the action window whose body/ids/route correspond to the action described in portal evidence
label_reason_legend.R-UPLOAD-CDN: presigned PUT to object storage; linked to the action by path equality with upload-url response meta.signed_url/data.path (data link, not timing)
label_reason_legend.R-STATUS-POLL: repeated get(ids) status query at fixed ~2.0 s cadence after the previous response, stops once url/thumbnail filled; counted as polling (action-initiated), still mapped to an APIOP and ACT
label_reason_legend.R-SDK-STATIC: static data file from staging-sdk host, editor re-render side effect, not part of library API
